hooks.text: Ninety tons of Venetian gunpowder waited inside Brescia as storms gathered.
Did ringing church bells stop lightning from striking the powder magazine in 1769?
Ninety tons of gunpowder sat stored inside the walled city of Brescia.

title: When Lightning Struck 90 Tons of Gunpowder 💥
description: On August 18, 1769, lightning struck a church bastion storing 90 tons of gunpowder in Brescia, Italy, leveling a sixth of the city.
